tonight.headline: Before kickoff: every starter is cleared — and Stroud locks at 07:30, before Daniels plays Monday
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice is out (hamstring, KCTV5 16 Oct) and Josh Jacobs is still on the exempt list this week. Los Cachanillas banked 5.2 on Thursday from Emanuel Wilson and fixed their lineup on Saturday (Pierce for Hurts, the Ravens for a defence on bye).

Your side needs nothing: 127.8 projected against 110.4, ESPN 59%, and it is the projection lineup. Tuten is active in London; Taylor, Wilson, Likely, Golden and Pickens are off their final reports; Daniels is not on Washington's report. One structural risk to know: your only backup quarterback, Stroud, plays at 07:30 this morning, so a Monday scratch of Daniels could not be covered.

case.label: Why nothing
case.body: Every starter cleared the final reports (Yahoo Colts report, Packers.com, Saints report and Panthers.com 16 Oct; SI Commanders 17 Oct). The margin is projection, not news.

case.label: Provisional
case.body: Written at 07:00, before the 09:30 and 16:50 inactive lists. A Sunday-morning call that rests on a designation is provisional — re-check at 09:30.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A surprise inactive: Taylor, Wilson or Likely at 09:30 — Worthy (kicks off 14:25) or Golden/Pickens can slide in. Golden or Pickens at 16:50: no unlocked receiver is left by then, so it cannot be covered. Daniels Monday 16:45: uncoverable.

case.label: The player
case.body: Arizona's lead back this week with Jeremiyah Love ruled out (ankle); Bam Knight is the only other back (Fantasy Footballers 16 Oct). The wire screen gives him 80% of Love's vacated share.

case.label: Why not a claim
case.body: Love is re-evaluated daily and Arizona say there is 'no discussion of IR' (TSN 16 Oct) — this is a handcuff while Love is out. A claim in IPADE drops you to last for the season, and STRATEGY forbids spending it on a patch or a handcuff. Tuten's Week 7 bye is already covered by Jacobs (eligible) and Gordon (back from bye).

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Love is ruled out for Week 7 or placed on IR and Jacobs's return is delayed by further discipline — then reconsider Tuesday with the drop named.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love misses Weeks 7-8 and Allgeier, unclaimed, outscores Gordon in both.
